description: A person stops a RUNNING loop (S55 T5, LC2): the daemon stops the loop's in-flight steps first (each parks suspended/user), lets the runner settle, then compare-and-set parks the loop waiting/stopped — one control event, the person's actor from the connection and the reason in its own column. The answer says what parked and where the loop now is; nothing was committed failed (a stop never races a step into failure, LC2's fixed order).
